Test Case Title: Login with valid email and password
Test Steps: 1. Launch app 2. Navigate to login screen 3. Enter valid email 4. Enter valid password 5. Tap Login
Expected Result: Vendor is logged in and redirected to dashboard/home screen
Actual Result: Login calls vendor login API; on success redirects via KYB status navigator

Test Steps: 1. Open login screen 2. Enter valid email 3. Enter wrong password 4. Tap Login
Expected Result: Error message shown (e.g. Invalid credentials); user stays on login screen
Actual Result: AuthError shown as snackbar; user stays on login screen

Test Steps: 1. Open login screen 2. Enter unregistered email 3. Enter any password 4. Tap Login
Expected Result: Proper error message shown; no crash; user not logged in
Actual Result: Server error surfaced as friendly snackbar; no crash

Test Steps: 1. Open login screen 2. Leave email and password empty 3. Tap Login
Expected Result: Inline validation errors shown for both fields; API not called
Actual Result: Form validation blocks submit; API not called on empty fields

Test Steps: 1. Open login screen 2. Enter invalid email format (e.g. abc@ or abc.com) 3. Tap Login
Expected Result: Validation error 'Enter a valid email' shown
Actual Result: Invalid email formats show inline 'Enter a valid email' error; API not called

Test Steps: 1. Open login screen 2. Type password 3. Tap eye/visibility icon
Expected Result: Password toggles between masked and visible
Actual Result: Eye icon toggles obscureText correctly

Test Steps: 1. Login successfully 2. Kill the app 3. Relaunch the app
Expected Result: User remains logged in and lands on dashboard (token stored in secure storage)
Actual Result: Session restored from secure storage on restart for approved vendors
Remarks: Non-approved vendors are intentionally logged out on restart (auth_bloc.dart:105)

Test Steps: 1. Launch app with expired token 2. Perform any API action
Expected Result: App redirects to login screen gracefully without crash
Actual Result: 401 response triggers SessionExpiryNotifier -> auto logout -> login screen

Test Case Title: Login button disabled during API call
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid credentials 2. Tap Login 3. Observe button while request is in progress
Expected Result: Loader shown; button disabled; duplicate taps do not fire multiple requests
Actual Result: AppButton is replaced by a spinner while loading; duplicate taps impossible

Test Steps: 1. Turn off internet 2. Enter valid credentials 3. Tap Login
Expected Result: User-friendly 'No internet connection' message shown; no crash
Actual Result: Dio connection errors map to 'No internet connection' message

Test Steps: 1. Open register screen 2. Fill all mandatory fields with valid data 3. Submit

Actual Result: Successful registration emits AuthOtpRequired and opens OTP screen

Test Steps: 1. Open register screen 2. Enter an email that already exists 3. Submit
Expected Result: 'Email already exists' error shown; user not registered again
Actual Result: Server 'email exists' error surfaced via snackbar; not registered again

Test Steps: 1. Enter existing email in email field 2. Move focus away / trigger check
Expected Result: App indicates email is already in use before form submission
Actual Result: CheckEmailExistsUseCase runs as email is entered (register_screen.dart:697)

Test Steps: 1. Open register screen 2. Leave one mandatory field empty at a time 3. Submit
Expected Result: Each empty mandatory field shows its own validation message
Actual Result: Every mandatory field has its own validator message

Test Steps: 1. Enter weak password or mismatched confirm password 2. Submit
Expected Result: Appropriate validation error shown; form not submitted
Actual Result: Confirm-password mismatch validated; 'strength' is only min 8 characters

Test Steps: 1. Enter phone number with letters or wrong length 2. Submit
Expected Result: Validation error for invalid phone number shown
Actual Result: Digits-only input formatter + country-specific min/max length

Test Steps: 1. Fill form and submit 2. Kill app before OTP verification 3. Reopen app and login/register again
Expected Result: User can resume or restart flow without being stuck in broken state

Test Steps: 1. Complete registration 2. Receive OTP 3. Enter correct OTP 4. Tap Verify
Expected Result: OTP accepted; user proceeds to next step (KYC/login/dashboard)
Actual Result: Correct OTP authenticates and routes via KYB status navigator

Test Steps: 1. Enter wrong OTP 2. Tap Verify
Expected Result: 'Invalid OTP' error shown; user remains on OTP screen
Actual Result: Invalid OTP error shown as snackbar; user stays on OTP screen

Test Steps: 1. Wait until OTP expires 2. Enter the old OTP 3. Tap Verify
Expected Result: 'OTP expired' error shown; resend option available
Actual Result: Expired OTP server error surfaced; resend option available

Test Steps: 1. Tap Resend OTP 2. Wait for new OTP 3. Enter new OTP

Test Steps: 1. Tap Resend OTP 2. Observe resend button
Expected Result: Resend disabled during countdown; timer counts down correctly and re-enables

Test Case Title: OTP field accepts only digits of correct length
Test Steps: 1. Try entering letters/special chars 2. Try entering more digits than allowed
Expected Result: Only numeric input of exact OTP length accepted

Test Steps: 1. Enter wrong OTP repeatedly (5+ times)

Test Steps: 1. Tap Forgot Password on login 2. Enter registered email 3. Submit
Expected Result: Reset OTP/link sent; confirmation message shown

Test Steps: 1. Open forgot password 2. Enter unregistered email 3. Submit

Remarks: Reset completes outside the app via emailed link

Test Case Title: Old password no longer works after reset
